items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 25 August 2026 11:55am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 25 August 2026 at 11:50am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds developing.


##Synopsis##

High pressure centred over Scandinavia extending a ridge across the British Isles.


##Wind##

East 3 to 5, increasing 5 or 6 late evening, then decreasing 4 or 5 by the morning tomorrow.


##State of Sea##

Slight becoming slight or moderate this evening.


##Weather##

Fair, then occasional rain developing overnight.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, falling moderate in rain later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

East 4 or 5, soon decreasing 3 or 4 Wednesday afternoon, then increasing 4 or 5 again for a time overnight into Thursday.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, soon becoming slight.


##Weather##

Occasional rain becoming fair for a time overnight into Thursday.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain.
